meta.title: Mir Tankov vehicle catalog
meta.description: Every vehicle in the game: search by name, filter by nation, class, tier, status and role. Open a tank’s card for its specs, stats and builds.

head.title: Vehicle catalog
head.description: Every vehicle in the game in one place. Find a tank by name or filter by nation, type and tier, then open its card.

preferential.title: Tanks with preferential matchmaking
preferential.description: Every Mir Tankov tank with preferential matchmaking, by tier, with specs, stats and builds.
preferential.intro: A tank with preferential matchmaking meets vehicles at most one tier above its own. It never ends up at the bottom of a list against tanks two tiers higher, which makes these tanks steady earners and comfortable to play.
preferential.criteria: The collection lists the vehicles the game client tags with preferential matchmaking. It follows the client data after every patch.

armored.title: Tanks with strong armor
armored.description: Armored Mir Tankov tanks and tank destroyers: assault and breakthrough heavies and assault tank destroyers, by tier, with specs and stats.
armored.intro: Armored vehicles lead the push: they break a flank, tank shots with their front and turret and draw the enemy's fire.
armored.criteria: The collection lists the vehicles the game client gives the assault heavy tank, breakthrough heavy tank or assault tank destroyer role, the roles meant for heavily armored vehicles.

scouts.title: Scouts: every light tank
scouts.description: Every Mir Tankov light tank, scouts and wheeled vehicles included, by tier, with specs, stats and builds.
scouts.intro: Light tanks spot: they find the enemy, light them up for the team and survive on speed and camouflage. Wheeled vehicles add raw speed and agility.
scouts.criteria: The collection lists every light tank in the catalog, wheeled vehicles included.

premium-farm.title: Tier VIII premium tanks for credits
premium-farm.description: Tier VIII Mir Tankov premium tanks you can get now, with specs and stats, to pick a credit earner.
premium-farm.intro: Premium tanks earn more credits per battle, and tier VIII pays best. These are the tanks players take to earn credits and train crews.
premium-farm.criteria: The collection lists tier VIII premium tanks with the Premium status, the ones on sale or available now. Reward and retired vehicles are left out.

collector.title: Collector vehicles
collector.description: Every Mir Tankov collector vehicle from lines removed from the tech tree, by tier, with specs and stats.
collector.intro: Collector vehicles come from lines removed from the tech tree. They need no research and keep the specs of their line's last version.
collector.criteria: The collection lists the vehicles the game client marks as collector vehicles.
